desc: Implement an offline fail-closed USB-root boot path: require exact removable right-port USB ancestry and stick identity, independently verify GPT/ext4 metadata read-only, reject dirty or ambiguous roots, and load Norwegian keymap before shells. Test synthetic regular files, mocked startup failures and real OpenRC/direct-ext4 shutdown on VM-owned temporary loop images. Preserve 305/6001 payloads and active SD shutdown work; no target access, physical block-device access, flashing, image enrollment or new SPMI/SMC transactions.
author: astra

progress.shutdown_tested: Contained host OpenRC + ext4, shell PID1; actual target poweroff pending
progress.remaining: Native static tools closure/reproducibility, root dev-provider and kernel/module review, physical109 identity, fresh initramfs packaging/preflight, actual BusyBox handoff/power dispatch and separate exact-artifact live review.
progress.static_e2fsck_package_inspected: e2fsprogs-static1.47.2-r2 has libraries only; no executable packaged

acceptance_criteria: Pin a fail-closed selector and bounded read-only GPT/ext4 helper against synthetic fixtures and the preserved098 regular-file image; no actual device access.
Keep the Norwegian map before all shells in a separately named init, with identity, e2fsck -f -n and ro,noload inspection before the first RW mount.
Exercise actual init startup/error/handoff and direct-ext4 OpenRC shutdown in a contained host harness before claiming readiness; no changes to live305/6001 payloads.
Prepare fresh root staging and initramfs packaging with known static tools, reviewed109 stick identity, two-build hashes and preflight before a separate exact-artifact live review.

host_test_scope.allowed: VM-owned loop devices over newly created files in the contained test scratch tree only; real ext4 and OpenRC, no physical target or removable disk.
host_test_scope.power_actions: Forbidden/intercepted in the harness; no reboot/poweroff syscall may reach the host.
